summary: Completed PRE-FIX P0 baseline only using disposable loopback Mongo + isolated ASGI auth override. Confirmed production traceback cause from RCA doc (price_cohort aggregate read timeout at socketTimeoutMS=45000), seeded 2,832 products + 100,811 snapshots, measured cold/repeat /api/my-products, captured aggregate explain stats, and validated synthetic aggregate timeout handling returns 500 (no silent empty success payload).

critical.issue: Real production traceback confirms TimeoutError from price_cohort aggregate read path (RCA source), still an endpoint-critical failure mode when aggregate exceeds socket timeout.

minor.issue: In observer mode with GuardedDatabase, both cold and repeat calls are live_fallback and dashboard_cache remains empty (before=0, after=0), so repeat requests do not gain cache relief.

ui_bugs.issue: Local UI loaded, but displayed "Release status is unavailable. Changes remain disabled." banner in smoke check.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console logged ws://localhost:443/ws connection refused during smoke run.

action_items: Implement P0 fix in application code (outside this baseline run), then rerun /app/backend/tests/test_p0_my_products_baseline.py for before/after comparison.

Preserve pricing correctness constraints during fix: no silent truncation, no empty-success fallback, no write-enablement workaround for caching, no production index/data mutation in this validation lane.
Recheck synthetic timeout behavior post-fix: response contract should remain explicit failure (not 200 empty data).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is extremely large (>12k lines), which raises maintainability and targeted RCA/debugging risk for latency-sensitive flows.
Current my-products cache-write path is best-effort and swallowed in observer mode, so request-path recompute pressure remains when cache cannot be persisted.

price_cohort aggregate pipeline still scans/returns large 180-day snapshot working set in baseline scale evidence (docs examined ~= rows returned), consistent with timeout susceptibility under larger production cardinality.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke-only; app loaded with release-status warning banner
